finalText:
All objectives verified complete.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created with title `dbp1 RD Bench Ticket`, Ref **RD-1015**, customer Marlow Bakery, initial status Draft, created 2026-08-24. The New ticket form required only Title (Customer was optional free text).

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `dbp1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (100 × 1.25).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `dbp1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (200 × 1.25). Ticket parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (150 × 1.25). Ticket parts total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Status control is a single "Mark Ready" button. First attempt was refused with a banner alert headed **"Ticket is not ready"** listing, verbatim:
- `Part "dbp1 RD Part A" has no supplier`
- `Part "dbp1 RD Part B" has no supplier`

**What was required:** every part on the ticket must have a supplier. I edited both parts to set supplier "Acme Parts" (all other values unchanged), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status changed from Draft to **Ready** (button set changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted via each row's Delete button → Confirm dialog → "Delete part" (accepted twice). Parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." (0 parts). Ticket archived via the "Archive ticket" button, which changed to "Unarchive ticket". Verified: with "Show archived" unchecked, RD-1015 does not appear in the ticket list (13 tickets, refs RD-1014…RD-1004) and no text containing "dbp1" appears anywhere in the active list; with "Show archived" checked, RD-1015 appears at the top labelled "dbp1 RD Bench Ticket Archived", status Ready, 0 parts. Nothing created by this run remains active.
